title: Marius offers protection

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Good to see you're still standing. You're taking this whole thing quite seriously. It's time for us to talk about survival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good to see you're still standing. You're taking this whole thing quite seriously. It's time for us to talk about survival.
What do you propose?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: And to think, I was actually growing to like you. See you in the morgue amigo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And to think, I was actually growing to like you. See you in the morgue amigo.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Great! I really wish this wasn't how things worked but here we are. Sad. So Sad... Fifty Lims should cover it for a few days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! I really wish this wasn't how things worked but here we are. Sad. So Sad... Fifty Lims should cover it for a few days.
I'm listening.
Surviving what?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: The carrousel, the maelstrom, the ring road of death... the catering cartel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The carrousel, the maelstrom, the ring road of death... the catering cartel.
The other bosses?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I've seen my fair share of business warfare. I think it's time we work out how to keep you safe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen my fair share of business warfare. I think it's time we work out how to keep you safe.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You know how putting meat in a freeze bag can keep it safe from dust-rot? I can be that bag for you. I could keep you safe. Let me be your bag.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know how putting meat in a freeze bag can keep it safe from dust-rot? I can be that bag for you. I could keep you safe. Let me be your bag.
I'm still listening.
This is making me uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: And I keep the wolf from your back, the bear from the door, the bosses from your kneecaps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I keep the wolf from your back, the bear from the door, the bosses from your kneecaps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Protection money? It sounds like a fair deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Protection money? It sounds like a fair deal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Protection money? It sounds like a fair deal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Protection money? It sounds like a fair deal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Protection money? It feels like a scam.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Protection money? It feels like a scam.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Protection money? It feels like a scam.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Protection money? It feels like a scam.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I'm only offering this to you because you seem like you need it, I'd hate to see that pretty little face get washed up in the docks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm only offering this to you because you seem like you need it, I'd hate to see that pretty little face get washed up in the docks.
Ok, let's do it.
I'll take my chances.
Is this a shakedown?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: The way I see this working, you offer me a modest stipend, a few Lims say every week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The way I see this working, you offer me a modest stipend, a few Lims say every week.
And?
Or?
